+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4BXTKA17C1EXCN9TZ152P5M
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'send caller (alias send parent): a run sends a message to its caller as mail'
+---
+## What
+Add the `send caller` operation. `send parent` is a noun synonym of it. A run sends a message to the session that started it, and the run continues. The calling session gets the message as mail, and the Router starts an answer for it. The calling session can be a parent run or the root host session.
+
+Also, `send agent` with an `id` that is the session id of the caller does the same as `send caller`. A run id is the session id, so the parent run id works as that `id`.
+
+External APIs (planned names, confirmed by the Extras and Router sessions):
+- Extras: `OperationEventKind.message` and `ToolContext.message(_ text: String) async`.
+- Router: `SessionEvent.runMessage(OperationEvent)`. The Router delivers an unheld `.message` on an open background-run token as mail, and starts an answer (Router kanban `^v270zf4`).
+
+First update `Package.resolved` to the Extras and Router `main` that have these APIs.
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolOperations.swift`: new `@Operation(verb: "send", noun: "caller", description: "Send a message to the session that started you. You continue to work. Your final message still goes to it when you end.") struct SendCaller { var message: String }`.
+  - `execute` uses `context.callerLink` (from the task "Each run with a caller gets the agents tool…"). With no link, it gives a corrective: "You have no caller."
+  - A blank message gives a corrective.
+  - Otherwise it calls `await link.call.message(message)` and gives `.success("The message was sent to your caller.")`.
+- `SendAgent.execute`: before `answer(forRun:)`, if `id` (with trimmed spaces, not case-sensitive) is `context.callerLink?.sessionID`, do the same as `SendCaller`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsTool.swift`: add `SendCaller` to the full and the messaging op lists. Add `nounAliases: ["parent": "caller"]` to the `OperationResolver`, next to `verbAliases`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolDescription.swift`: when the context has a caller link, add one sentence: "The session that started you has the id <id>. Send a message to it with {\"op\": \"send caller\", \"message\": \"...\"}."
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Tool/AgentsToolText.swift`: the texts above.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A child run that calls `send caller` while it is running causes a new answer in the parent session. The message text is in the mail of that answer. The child continues and ends later with its final message.
+- [ ] `{"op": "send parent", ...}` resolves to `send caller`.
+- [ ] `send agent` with the id of the parent run also delivers the message to the parent session.
+- [ ] A host-started run with a full tool and no caller gets the "You have no caller." corrective.
+- [ ] The description of a tool with a caller link names the caller id.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/SendCallerTests.swift` with the scripted model:
+  - a child posts a message;
+  - the parent run gets a `.runMessage` and answers the mail;
+  - the child then finishes;
+  - the parent gets the final message.
+- [ ] Alias test: `send parent` resolves. Parent-id test: `send agent` with the caller id delivers.
+- [ ] Update `AgentsToolSchemaTests.swift` (the op lists of the full and the messaging tools) and `AgentsToolDescriptionTests.swift` (the caller sentence).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then do the implementation until they pass. #waits-on-extras #waits-on-router
\ No newline at end of file
